max_segments.description: Keeps the narration surface small and readable.
max_segments.title: Max Segments

alpha.description: Mann-Kendall significance for calling a direction.
alpha.title: Alpha

min_periods.description: Below this a slope is not meaningfully estimable.
min_periods.title: Min Periods

flat_slope_pct.description: A per-period rate at or above this |%/period| is material on its own.
flat_slope_pct.title: Flat Slope Pct

min_total_change_pct.description: A trend is also material if it moves the level this much end to end, however slowly. Matches the Materiality.min_abs_pct convention. Both bars exist because neither alone works: a rate test calls a 0.4%/period drift flat when it compounds to +52% over two years, and a cumulative test alone would flag a barely-moving series measured over a long enough window.
min_total_change_pct.title: Min Total Change Pct

min_history.description: Fewer periods than this and the profile is marked unusable.
min_history.title: Min History

seasonality_floor.description: Below this strength, report no seasonality rather than subtract noise. Calibrated above the p99 of STL seasonal strength on pure noise; see configs/eda/default.yaml for the measured null distribution.
seasonality_floor.title: Seasonality Floor

outlier_z.description: Modified-z cutoff for the descriptive outlier share.
outlier_z.title: Outlier Z
